_note_gasProjectJson: scriptId/testSheetId are ALSO committed project truth in gas-project.json (GAS-Core adr/0004) — gas-deploy reads that copy. Kept here too because tests/conftest.py's script_id fixture and tests/playwright/editor_helpers.js read local.settings.json directly, not through gas-deploy's loader (GAS-Core-rgh).
_note_standardDocs: This project uses three distinct standard/human-maintained Google Docs, documented together in knowledge-base/references/Standard-Docs.md -- do not conflate them: testDocId (template, cloned per pytest session, never mutated directly), referenceDocId (canonical APT doc, mutated IN PLACE by decode_reference_document), copyFidelitySourceDocId (stable source, only ever cloned -- never mutated).
_note_testDocId: Master session-template doc. Cloned once per pytest session via begin_test_session (src/TestFixtures.js's beginTestSession); the clone, not this doc, is what tests actually mutate. Trashed at session teardown.
_note_teamScopeFolders: Folder hierarchy for Team Scope sync tests (gts-me6w.6). Create via the setup_team_scope_fixture GAS fixture, which also registers TestTeamA/TestTeamAChild in TeamData.
_note_axiom: Used by scripts/query_axiom.py and src/WebApp.js's set_axiom_config route. axiomToken is the ingest token (write-only, used by GasLogger.flush() server-side); axiomQueryToken is a separate read-only API token for querying — get both from the Axiom org settings.
_note_exportRootFolderId: gts-z6j0. Drive folder ID that getExportFolder_() (src/ExportFolderMap.js) creates per-document export subfolders under, so document-exporter output (JSON/PDF, and future image-extraction artifacts) stays out of each source document's own folder/visibility. Create the folder once by hand and paste its ID here; pushed to the GAS WebApp's EXPORT_ROOT_FOLDER_ID script property at deploy:test via set_export_config (manage-deployments.js's registerExportConfig). Optional — if unset, exports fall back to writing into the source document's own parent folder.
_note_exportTestDocId: Default docId scripts/export_gas.py uses when no doc_id is given on the command line. Optional — if unset, doc_id becomes a required positional argument.
_note_referenceDocId: Canonical Action-Portable-Text (APT) reference doc used by scripts/apt.py's encode/decode_reference_document and tests/test_doc_oracle_reference.py, tests/test_reference_corpus_fixture.py. WARNING: decode_reference_document clears and rewrites this doc's body — unlike testDocId/copyFidelitySourceDocId, this doc IS mutated in place by normal test/tooling runs.
_note_copyFidelitySourceDocId: Real, human-maintained Doc with ADR-0027-grammar floating actions, used only as a read-only clone source by tests/test_floating_action_copy_fidelity.py (clone_doc_with_test_id). Never mutated directly — all mutation happens on a disposable clone trashed at teardown. Distinct from referenceDocId (mutated in place) and testDocId (session-clone template).
_note_testToken: Auto-populated by pnpm run deploy:test — do not edit manually.
_note_webappTestUrl: Auto-written by pnpm run deploy:test from the TEST-WEB-APP deployment ID — do not set manually. deploy:test always overwrites this with the current derived URL so it cannot become stale.
_note_staticPortalRepoPath: Sibling checkout of the Static repo (nuuc-it/Static) that GitHub Pages serves. Used by scripts/static-pages.js (GAS-Core's gas-static package, chained automatically into pnpm run deploy:test/deploy:prod) to publish the built team-action portal to pub/AS-sit/ (SIT) or pub/AS/ (PROD).
_note_playwrightAccounts: Maps this project's test-account roles (docs/security-architecture.md §5) to shared, cross-project auth-identity files under $PLAYWRIGHT_AUTH_DIR (.envrc, default ~/.playwright). Capture a file with: node tests/playwright/auth.setup.js --account=<slug>
_note_claspAuth: clasp credential file used for every clasp call for this project. Without it clasp falls back to ~/.clasprc.json and can push to the wrong script project. Create with: clasp_config_auth=~/.clasprc-<name>.json clasp login
